topic.title: Other NEM BIOS Considerations

ul.li: BIOSmust not read/write to obsoleted MSRs. For example: MSR_UNC_CBO_CONFIG 0x396.
BIOSis no longer required for clearingMCA banks after NEM exit. Instead, BIOS should print the MCA bank status in Debug logs while exiting NEM mode.
When boot from Hub-die E-core, NEM Setup need to alter due to lack of LLC.
